lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the gill slits, following the longitudinal curvature of the trunk.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots to create a rectilinear grid-like configuration on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibiting sharp vertical luminance gradients (bright upper edge, dark lower shadow) running parallel to the lateral line across the upper flank.

other_distinctive_markers: One remora (Echeneidae) is visible as a dark, elongated silhouette attached to the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
